title: Merchandise Purchases — Held-Funds Day Count by Tender for Registry Credit Corrections
content:
For a refund of registry credit left undeducted on a Merchandise Purchases unit, the held-funds days run from the last capture date of the unit's payment to the request date, and are counted by the tender on the purchase record:

- **Debit card or cash** — whose money left the customer on the capture date: the calendar days from the last capture date to the request date counting both dates.
- **Bank credit card** — those calendar days not counting the capture date.

A unit paid by any other tender (a Marlowe & Finch card, a gift card or mixed tender) is outside this rule.

## Worked counts (hypothetical: last capture 1 June, request 24 June)

| Tender | Held-funds days |
|---|---|
| debit | 24 — 1 June through 24 June, both counted |
| cash | 24 |
| bank card | 23 — 2 June through 24 June |

When the unit's payment was captured more than once, the count starts from the latest capture date.
